items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: You got the minstrels -- you got Huntington's Mighty Minstrels, you got Al G. Fields Minstrels.

ctx.x: Was Bert Williams -- he was performing on the stage prior to you.
Oh, he was before me, sure he was. Sure he was. So was Johnson. There were quite a few on before I was but they

weren't in the business. I hope you can get the understanding that these people were on the stage before me but where were they on the stage? Where were they? If you're talking about a theater, you're not in any theater in the united world unless you are at the Palace or the Paladium as of today and as of 20 years ago. So where were they if they were on the stage? Where were they? You got the minstrels -- you got Huntington's Mighty Minstrels, you got Al G. Fields Minstrels. You got so many minstrels that's going…
